blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to hear out, to listen (to the end)
to deceive, to cheat, to trick, to swindle
to flash (to briefly illuminate a scene)
to catch (up), to pick up, to grasp, to snatch
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: выслу́шивать — to hear out, to listen (to the end); обма́нывать — to deceive, to cheat, to trick, to swindle; вспы́хивать — to flash (to briefly illuminate a scene); подхва́тывать — to catch (up), to pick up, to grasp, to snatch.
**дога́дываться** — to guess (to reach an unqualified conclusion). Wiktionary: догада́ться + -ывать.
**выска́кивать** — to jump out, to leap out. Wiktionary: выскочить + -ивать.
**испы́тывать** — to try, to test, to assay. Wiktionary: испыта́ть + -ывать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to guess (to reach an unqualified conclusion)
to jump out, to leap out
to try, to test, to assay
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: дога́дываться — to guess (to reach an unqualified conclusion); выска́кивать — to jump out, to leap out; прочи́тывать — to read through; испы́тывать — to try, to test, to assay.
